source_path_notation: Zero-based JSONPath; missing fields point to their existing parent.
interpretive_boundaries: Color and shape are separate identified attributes; a null shape or an abstained joint response does not erase known color.
Selected commands and command-conditioned forecasts are not evidence of execution. command_executed is the explicit execution flag.
Pending is not answered; abstained is not answered. Response nulls do not replace identified attribute fields.
observed_history null means unavailable history, not a known empty history. The last supplied entry is only the latest supplied historical command, not proof of a relationship to the present command.
No literal latestcommand field is supplied; latest supplied historical command is derived only from an available history.
predicted_current and predicted_by_command are model content. Recovery values are model forecasts, not physical truth, appearance, felt clarity, confidence, or measured allocation.
Output nodes supply identified attributes without selected_position or recovery_by_delay. Copying content does not supply allocation.
Missing fields are absent evidence, not negative or zero values. No physical correctness, physical scene, subjective appearance, felt clarity, or answer confidence is supplied.
